title: GameWish
description: GameWish is a lightweight Minecraft plugin that sends players a personal “Good luck in the game!” message when they join the server, creating a friendly atmosphere.
body: GameWish is a lightweight Minecraft plugin that greets players with a friendly wish when they join the server. It creates a warm and welcoming atmosphere without adding unnecessary complexity. The plugin works out of the box with no configuration required. Every player receives a personal message directly in chat. Simple, clean, and perfect for adding a touch of friendliness to your server.
